title: Boiler Inspection Technician Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Boiler Inspection: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Boiler Inspection Technician Sign-Off Form covers boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop. The facility boiler coordinator records Boiler Inspection performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Boiler Inspection Technician Sign-Off Form keeps Boiler Inspection exceptions visible until the facility boiler coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Boiler Inspection Technician Sign-Off Form at boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system. Document boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop identity before Boiler Inspection begins. Compare boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop findings with stated Boiler Inspection criteria; route unresolved Boiler Inspection issues to qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer. For Boiler Inspection Technician Sign-Off Form, confirm requirements for Boiler Inspection. Ask qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer to review Boiler Inspection conditions beyond the facility boiler coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completion parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Boiler Inspection, identify responsible parties, boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system, and the linked boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop source.

fields.label: Make, model, serial, rating, fuel, and permit reference
Operating schedule, service history, and inspection basis

sections.title: Completion checks and remaining limitations
sections.guidance: Capture Boiler Inspection facts for boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Boiler Inspection completion checks
items: Visible vessel, piping, valve, pump, and leak condition
Burner, flame, fuel-train, and ignition observation
Vent, draft, combustion-air, and room condition
Pressure, temperature, level, and makeup-water indication
Limit, cutoff, relief, alarm, and control response
Startup, operating, shutdown, and lockout sequence

sections.title: Verified outcome and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Boiler Inspection conditions; have facility boiler coordinator assign the next Boiler Inspection owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Low-water, limit, relief, or cutoff failure
Unsafe pressure, temperature, venting, or vessel condition
Test requires authority or shutdown not available
Combustion or operating readings by instrument
blocks.guidance: Pause Boiler Inspection when a fuel, combustion, pressure-boundary, venting, or required safety-control concern remains. Retain the available Boiler Inspection proof and route unresolved boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop scope to facility boiler coordinator.
